title: Editor

noGame.title: Editor: select a game
noGame.desc: Open the library and select a game with a config to view and edit its parameters.

noConfig.title: Config not found
noConfig.default: On the Library tab, click Set config and select Saved/Config/Windows, WindowsNoEditor, WinGDK, or WindowsClient.

tabs.advancedHint: Engine.ini and CVars: for experienced users
tabs.backupsHint: Ini snapshots before apply and rollback

mode.basicBody: “In game file” keys were in ini when you opened the game: edit values only, not removable. Catalog extras use Add/Remove from ini.
mode.advancedBody: Fine engine tuning. May create or change Engine.ini / Scalability.ini. For experienced users.
mode.backupsBody: Automatic ini snapshots stored locally by the app. Restore or reset to a clean config.
mode.extraBody: Input.ini and DeviceProfiles.ini from the game config folder. Read-only: editing via GSM is not supported yet.
mode.presetsBody: Presets saved from the editor. Import, export, apply to the game config, and delete.

engineWarning.title: Advanced users only
engineWarning.body: Engine.ini CVars may conflict with in-game settings and sg.*, and break stability or performance.
engineWarning.backupHint: Create a backup before applying (Backups tab).
engineWarning.ackHint: Check “Got it” to dismiss this warning.
engineWarning.inline: Engine.ini: advanced CVars may conflict with in-game settings.

engineIni.title: Ini parameters (Engine / Scalability / Game)
engineIni.before: Use “Add to ini” and “Remove from ini” to control whether a line exists in the file: the key is written or removed after “Apply”. Currently in ini: {{on}} of {{total}}.

emptyFiltered.descSearch: Try another query or switch the category.
emptyFiltered.descEmpty: This category has no parameters for the selected game.

gameRunningInline: Applying changes is disabled while the game is running.

errors.noChanges: No changes: enable Engine.ini parameters or change values.

applied: Applied {{count}} edits · backup {{backupId}}. Restart the game.

conflict.bannerBody_one: {{count}} parameter: a GUS quality preset overlaps a manual Engine/Scalability.ini override.
conflict.bannerBody_other: {{count}} parameters: sg.* presets overlap manual r.* overrides in ini.
conflict.resolved: Removed conflicting r.* overrides; {{sg}} unchanged. Apply to write ini.

detailPane.hint: Hover a parameter in the list on the left: its description will appear on the right.

engineToggle.off: Not in ini. Click “Add to ini” and “Apply” to write the key.
engineToggle.on: Will be in ini after “Apply”. Click “Remove from ini” to delete the key.

sentinelHint: The ini holds −1: the game substitutes its own value. Set 0–4 or another number to fix it manually.

noDiff.title: No changes
noDiff.desc: The current ini files on disk match the selected preset.

diffCount_one: {{count}} change will be written to ini
diffCount_other: {{count}} changes will be written to ini

presets.empty: No saved presets yet: save current edits or import a JSON file.

validation.acknowledgeWarnings: I understand the risks: apply with warnings
validation.limitsPending: Scalability limits are still loading: wait before applying
validation.gpuPending: GPU info is still loading: wait before applying Ray Tracing changes
validation.sgRConflict: sg/r conflict: {{sg}} overlaps manual r.* overrides
validation.shippedKeyRemoval: {{key}} cannot be removed: it was in the game ini when you opened the editor

combo.rtLowShadows: Ray Tracing enabled with low sg.ShadowQuality ({{shadows}}): artifacts or FPS drops possible
combo.rtNoHardware: Ray Tracing enabled but GPU does not support RT in UE
combo.rtGpuUnknown: Could not detect GPU: Ray Tracing may not work on your graphics card
combo.engineScalabilityDup: {{key}} in both Engine.ini and Scalability.ini: last write wins
combo.streamingTexture: Large r.Streaming.PoolSize ({{pool}}) with low sg.TextureQuality ({{texture}}): VRAM pressure

extra.emptyDesc: These files were not found in the game config folder.
extra.readOnlyHint: Read-only. Changes to these files are not supported in GSM yet.
